structural_change: h3 (Q-COMPUTE-ELEM r14): h2 CTS refused by the strict multiple-CTS profile (ck_head drove 4,831 std FF + 2 raw SRAM clock pins: mixed source). The two program SRAMs now take explicit raw-macro clock entries ck_pm0/ck_pm1 (qfd_tt_ctlm_head_static_rk, derived by tools/qwen_split/derive_tt_head_rawck.py; shared source unchanged), W-face pins at the SRAM clk heights; std roots ck_head / ck_me_sched unchanged (clock hybrid_entries, flow 891a5f188). Parent delivers ck_pm0/1 from the same PLL phase as ck_head (same_pll_fixed_phase 0 ps). Logic, edges and outline unchanged. NEW head-side leaf of the selected static TT controller: exact original parent body minus the ROM tree (u_head + native route + resident relocation + loaded stage), formally equivalent regrouping (physical/qwen_tt_static_cluster_1015). Roots ck_head (4,813+route) / ck_me_sched (877), related phase-0; 2 SRAM 64x512; no ICG.
